name: MultiSelectItem
description: Combines `MultiSelect.ItemPrimitive` and `MultiSelect.ItemIndicatorPrimitive` into a single part, with the check mark after the label. Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: value
props.description: A unique value that identifies this select item.

props.name: children
props.description: Label of the option, such as its text or an icon with text. The check mark is added after it.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: label
props.description:
Specifies the text label to use when the item is matched during keyboard text navigation.

Defaults to the item text content if not provided.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description:
Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it
via the `render` prop.
Set to `true` if the rendered element is a native button.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: MultiSelect.Item.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
